scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with buildings on both sides, featuring a mix of old and new architecture, including a tall yellow building on the left and a beige building on the right with a black garage door covered in graffiti. The street is paved with cobblestones and has a few pedestrians walking along the sidewalk. A man stands on the corner, waiting to cross the street, while another person walks down the sidewalk. The sky is blue with white clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The beige building on the right has a large window on the second floor and a smaller one on the first floor, both covered in graffiti. The yellow building on the left has balconies on each floor.
scene_analysis.materials: The beige building has a stone facade with a decorative metal lamp post attached to its side. The yellow building has a smooth concrete facade.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and trash cans along the sidewalk, as well as a few potted plants.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The street is lined with trees and bushes, adding a touch of greenery to the urban landscape.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a stop sign, a pedestrian crossing signal, and a directional sign.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be residential, with a few shops and cafes nearby.
